description: Hold-out genuine case, written blind from the brief's family description. The message is simulated and the people in it are illustrative. The payer of a parcel stalled for over a week, at a low price, asks for a refund.

messages.body: Hello, my clutch bag order KIK-1026 has been stuck at the Eldoret depot for over a week with no update. I needed it for an event that's now passed. Can I get a refund?
